Partner FAQ

Everything a reseller asks first

The questions that decide whether you sign — answered up front.

Can I fully white-label the platform under my brand? +
Completely. The platform, client sign-up, AI agents, dashboards and even the WhatsApp number carry your brand and domain. Your clients interact with your brand — they never see Engati.
I'm already on another BSP. How does migration work? +
We handle it. Our team manages the move of your existing client accounts, WhatsApp templates and configurations onto Engati's native BSP with minimal downtime. Most partners are live within days, not weeks.
What do the economics actually look like for me? +
Platform fee runs $6K–$15K/yr and you typically sell at $2K–$4K per client — so you break even at 2–4 clients. From there it compounds: roughly 4 clients in Year 1 to 10–11 in Year 2, even accounting for 30% churn, with usage revenue on top.
Will Engati ever contact or compete for my clients? +
Never. We don't contact your clients and we don't compete on your deals. The client relationship stays entirely yours — that's the core of the reseller model.
Which channels and AI capabilities can I resell? +
WhatsApp, Instagram, RCS, Web and Voice AI — sold as AI Agents, WhatsApp campaigns (CTWA, broadcasts, retargeting), Voice AI with zero SIP cost, Flow Bots, a live-chat inbox and analytics. Two low-code platforms: Agentic (AI) and Bot (flow-based).
Do you support partners in my region? +
Yes. We actively support reseller partners across India, the Middle East / GCC, Africa, Eastern Europe and Southeast Asia, with a dedicated partner manager from day one.
How long until I'm set up and ready to sell? +
14 days end to end: agreement and onboarding (day 1–2), training and certification (day 3–5), first client setup (day 6–10), then launch and optimise (day 11–14). You get the white-labeled platform, partner manager, sales kit, demo sandbox, co-branded materials and technical support from Day 1.
